scope: Isolated experimental generator completes tremolo tails; app library is unchanged

app.method: Full-score MIDI generation with alphaTab; exact played bar order/ticks, tempo events, attack multiplicity and note start/end pairs
app.caution: Timing effects such as staccato, grace notes and repeats can cause differences even when core notation matches; this is not a listening test. Difference counts are sorted event positions, not independent musical errors. The app engine can omit tremolo tails of 10 ticks or less in both files; equality does not establish complete repetitions.

limitations: Application library is unchanged; the fix is opt-in and experimental only
Private bundled alphaTab method is pinned by hash and requires revalidation after changes
Original and reference comparisons still share an engine; independent expected-tick tests cover the repaired tremolo boundary
Same 82-candidate corpus, no new blind PDFs; no audio rendering or device listening verification
